name: Autodromo Internazionale Enzo e Dino Ferrari
layout: Grand Prix circuit without Variante Bassa (WEC 6 Hours of Imola 2026)

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap highway=raceway ways with circuit turn refs (Overpass API, (c) OSM contributors, ODbL); Variante Bassa (T21) excluded as in the F1/WEC 4.909 km layout. Station 0 on the start line by the start gantry, located on the Regione Emilia-Romagna 2022 orthophoto.
sources.width: Measured on Regione Emilia-Romagna orthophoto RER2022_RGB 20 cm (ArcGIS ImageServer servizigis.regione.emilia-romagna.it/arcgis/rest/services/public/RER2022_RGB) from edge-line/kerb pairs every 12 m (~90% of samples), gaps interpolated.
sources.elevation: Regione Emilia-Romagna DTM 0.5 m from 2022-23 airborne LiDAR (DtmRER2022 ImageServer, CC BY 4.0), heights RDN2008 / Italian orthometric; ~15 m smoothing, tunnel/bridge dips removed.
sources.camber: Same LiDAR DTM: crossfall from edge samples 1.2 m inside each edge vs centre, smoothed.
sources.pit: OSM way "Pit Lane" (entry after Rivazza / before Variante Bassa, exit before Tamburello).
sources.trim: Medium-high downforce: many chicanes and slow corners, short straights (relative to Spa = 1.0).
sources.pitLimit: FIA WEC pit lane speed limit 60 km/h (WEC Sporting Regulations; applies at Imola).
sources.pitLoss: WEC pit loss depends on refuelling/driver change; not published, omitted.

notes: Turn numbers follow the circuit (autodromoimola.it, as tagged in OSM): 1-20 used; 21 (Variante Bassa) is bypassed in this layout. Anticlockwise. There are two transverse lines on the pit straight ~240 m apart; station 0 is the forward one at the start gantry.
